issue_request: FHIR-23558 is Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core search. It asked to clarify how date search parameters match periods, with the accepted resolution adding date-section text that date searches intrinsically match against periods and directing readers to the prefixes section for period/range comparison behavior.

Commit 9beb82390ffc77752f40a14fff9a25abb6d7c3ef changed source/search.html in September 2022 by adding the requested period-matching sentence and prefix reference, but its subject says FHIR-23588; Jira FHIR-23588 is an unrelated Da Vinci CDex typo, so the source application appears to have been committed under a mistyped key.
additional_context: source/search.html is the active Search narrative page, and source/fhir.ini's search-rules comment explicitly references maintaining the search.html summary table. Current source/search.html:2930-2949 states that date searches match periods regardless of underlying element type, explains conversion of date/dateTime/instant/Period/Timing to periods, and links to Prefixes. source/search.html:2326-2379 defines eq as containment and gt/ge/lt/le as range intersections/overlaps. The original Zulip thread confirms the contained-versus-overlap question and implementer understanding that eq is containment while gt/lt/ge/le overlap. FHIR-19909 is a closely related Resolved - No Change issue relying on the same interval semantics, and later FHIR-40304 clarified the section further with an audit already on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current date and prefix sections already satisfy the final Jira request, and an additional source edit would be redundant or merely editorial.
